description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveStatusWithLengthDays' used to encapsulate information about a leave status, including its ID, name, and duration in days. It provides getter, setter, and adder methods for managing these properties within the OrangeHRM leave plugin module.

classes.name: LeaveStatusWithLengthDays
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class representing a leave status with an additional property for length in days, including methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize leave status with ID, name, and length days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length in days of the leave.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length in days of the leave.

methods.name: addToLengthDays
methods.description: Adds a value to the current length in days.
